stem: During observation, which finding best indicates that the patient's Spirit (Shen) is present?

options.A: Dull, cloudy eyes with slow and inappropriate responses
options.B: Sudden brightening of the eyes after weeks of lethargy
options.C: Bright, clear eyes with alert and appropriate responses
options.D: Fixed upward gaze with no response to questions

stem: An 82-year-old patient who has been bedridden, lethargic, and barely eating for several weeks suddenly becomes bright-eyed and talkative and asks for food. Both cheeks show a bright red flush like applied rouge. Which of the following best describes this presentation?

options.A: Recovery of Stomach Qi with a favorable prognosis
options.B: False Spirit (Jia Shen) signaling imminent separation of Yin and Yang
options.C: Liver Fire blazing upward and agitating the Spirit
options.D: Yin deficiency with Empty Heat rising to the face

stem: In five-color observation of the complexion, a yellow color is primarily associated with which organ and pathogenic factor?
A patient has redness confined to the cheekbones that becomes more pronounced in the afternoon, while the rest of the face is pale. Which mechanism best explains this finding?

options.A: Full Heat in the Stomach flushing upward along its channel
options.B: Wind-Heat invading the exterior and rising to the face
options.D: Yin deficiency with Empty Heat floating upward

stem: A patient's face is bright white and slightly puffy. Which pattern is most consistent with this complexion?
A patient with a chronic illness has a complexion that, although pale, remains moist and lustrous. Which of the following is the best interpretation of the luster?

options.A: Stomach Qi is still intact and the prognosis is relatively favorable
options.B: Pathogenic Heat is still confined to the exterior
options.C: Dampness is accumulating in the face
options.D: Yin and Yang are about to separate

stem: In observation of the eyes, redness of the inner and outer canthi is attributed to which organ?
A patient's lips are bluish-purple. Which pattern is most consistent with this finding?

A 52-year-old patient reports a mildly sore, dry throat for 4 months, worse in the evening, with a sensation of heat in the palms and soles. On observation the throat is slightly red without swelling or exudate. Which pattern is most likely?

options.B: Kidney Yin deficiency with Empty Fire
options.D: Phlegm and Qi obstructing the throat

stem: A 3-year-old child with a high fever develops a fixed upward stare and stiffness of the neck. These eye findings most strongly indicate which of the following?
A tongue is pale, swollen, and wet, with teeth marks along the edges. Which pattern is most consistent with these findings?
A patient has a red tongue body. Which coating finding would most strongly indicate Yin deficiency with Empty Heat rather than Full Heat?

options.C: Absent coating with a shiny surface

stem: A bluish-purple tongue body that is moist most commonly indicates which of the following?

options.A: Interior Cold leading to Blood stasis
options.B: Interior Heat leading to Blood stasis

stem: A patient's tongue has multiple cracks on its surface. Which additional tongue finding would most strongly support attributing the cracks to Yin deficiency rather than to Spleen Qi deficiency?

options.A: Pale body with a thin white coating
options.D: Pale body with a wet surface

stem: A tongue that deviates to one side when protruded is most commonly associated with which of the following?
A patient's tongue trembles when protruded. The body is pale and slightly flaccid. Which mechanism best explains the tremor?

options.A: Liver Wind generated by extreme Heat
options.C: Qi and Blood deficiency failing to nourish the tongue
options.D: Liver Yang rising from Yin deficiency

stem: A pale tongue has a grey-black coating that is moist and slippery. Which of the following is the most appropriate interpretation?

options.B: Extreme Interior Cold from Yang deficiency
options.C: Damp-Heat accumulating in the Middle Burner

stem: A thick, white, greasy (sticky) tongue coating on a swollen body most commonly indicates which of the following?

options.A: Cold-Damp or Phlegm retained in the Interior

stem: A tongue coating looks as though it has been sprinkled onto the surface; it can be scraped away easily and leaves the surface clean beneath it. Which of the following is the most appropriate interpretation?

options.A: An exterior pathogen that has just begun to invade
options.B: Retention of Food in the Stomach

stem: A tongue has a thin white coating over most of its surface, but in the center the coating is missing and the surface there is smooth and shiny. Which pattern is most consistent with this finding?

A 29-year-old patient reports insomnia with vivid dreams, palpitations, and recurrent mouth ulcers for 3 weeks. The tongue is red at the tip with red points, and the coating is thin yellow. The pulse is rapid. Which pattern is most consistent with these findings?
Which area of the tongue reflects the condition of the Kidney?
On inspection of the underside of the tongue, the two sublingual veins are distended and dark purple. This finding most commonly indicates which of the following?

A 35-year-old patient has had chills, mild fever, headache, body aches, and nasal congestion for 1 day. The tongue body is of normal color with a thin white coating. The tongue findings are most consistent with which of the following?
A patient's fingernails are pale, brittle, and ridged. Which pattern is most consistent with this finding?
A patient lies curled up on the side facing the wall, keeps the covers pulled tightly around the body, and is quiet and still. These observations most suggest which of the following?

options.A: A Cold pattern of a Yin nature
options.B: A Heat pattern of a Yang nature

stem: A 60-year-old patient with a chronic cough brings up copious, thin, white, frothy sputum that is easy to expectorate. The patient feels cold and has a pale tongue with a white, slippery coating. The sputum findings are most consistent with which of the following?
A patient passes loose, watery stools that contain undigested food and have little odor. The limbs are cold. The stool findings are most consistent with which of the following?

options.B: Retention of Food in the Stomach
options.D: Liver Qi stagnation invading the Spleen

stem: Urine that is clear, pale, and copious most commonly indicates which of the following?

A 34-year-old patient reports painful periods. The menstrual blood is dark purple with clots, and the pain eases after the clots are passed. The blood findings most strongly indicate which of the following?

options.D: Spleen Qi failing to hold the Blood

stem: A low, weak voice with reluctance to speak most commonly indicates which of the following?
A patient with a high fever speaks loudly and incoherently and is agitated. Which of the following best describes this speech and its mechanism?

options.A: Muttering (Zheng Sheng) from Heart Qi deficiency
options.B: Soliloquy from Phlegm misting the Heart
options.C: Delirious speech (Zhan Yu) from Heat harassing the Heart
options.D: Stuttering from Wind-Phlegm obstructing the channels

stem: A 44-year-old singer has had a hoarse, weak voice for 8 months that is worse in the evening, with a dry throat and night sweats. Which pattern is most consistent with these findings?
A 68-year-old patient suddenly develops slurred, stuttering speech together with deviation of the mouth and numbness of one arm. The speech finding most strongly indicates which of the following?
Which of the following cough qualities most strongly indicates a deficiency pattern?

options.A: Loud, coarse cough with copious sputum
options.B: Heavy, muffled cough with nasal obstruction
options.C: Paroxysmal cough with loud rattling of Phlegm
options.D: Low, feeble cough with shortness of breath on exertion

stem: A dry, hacking cough with little or no sputum, where any sputum is scanty and difficult to expectorate, together with a dry throat, most commonly indicates which of the following?

options.B: Wind-Cold impairing the Lung's diffusing function
options.C: Insufficient Lung fluids from Dryness or Yin deficiency
options.D: Lung Qi deficiency with weak diffusing

stem: A 71-year-old patient has had breathlessness for 3 years that worsens with slight exertion. Breathing is shallow and weak, inhalation is more difficult than exhalation, and the patient feels relief after a long, deep breath in. Which mechanism best explains this breathing pattern?

options.C: Lung Qi deficiency with weak diffusing
options.D: Liver Qi stagnation with Qi counterflow

stem: Breathing accompanied by a whistling or rattling sound in the throat (wheezing, Xiao) most commonly indicates which of the following?

options.B: Phlegm obstructing the Lung and airways

stem: A patient who has been severely ill for many months, emaciated and very weak, begins to have hiccups that are low, feeble, and intermittent. Which of the following is the most appropriate interpretation?

options.A: Stomach Heat causing Qi to rebel upward
options.B: Cold in the Stomach from ingestion of raw food
options.D: Exhaustion of Stomach Qi, an unfavorable prognostic sign

stem: Frequent sighing is most commonly a manifestation of which of the following?
In olfaction, an odor from the body, breath, or excretions that is strong, foul, or putrid generally indicates which of the following?
A patient's breath is foul-smelling. The gums are swollen and painful, the patient is thirsty, and the tongue has a yellow coating. Which pattern is most consistent with these findings?

options.A: Retention of Food in the Stomach

stem: A 40-year-old patient has had diarrhea for 2 days. The stools are yellow and loose, extremely foul-smelling, and passed with a burning sensation of the anus. Which pattern is most consistent with the stool odor and these findings?
A patient reports a vaginal discharge that is thin and white with a fishy odor. The odor and appearance of this discharge most commonly indicate which of the following?

options.B: Heat toxin accumulating in the Lower Burner
options.D: Kidney Yin deficiency with Empty Heat

stem: A patient belches frequently after meals, and the belches carry a sour, rotten odor. There is epigastric fullness that is worse after eating. Which pattern is most consistent with these findings?

options.A: Retention of Food in the Stomach

stem: A practitioner notes that the pulse is wiry and forceful only at the guan (middle) position of the patient's right wrist, while all other positions are normal. Under the standard position-organ correspondence, this finding most directly reflects which organ?
A 55-year-old patient reports palpitations and poor sleep. The practitioner wishes to palpate the position that most directly reflects the Heart. Which position is most appropriate?
A normal pulse is said to have Stomach Qi, Spirit (Shen), and root. Which palpatory finding best demonstrates that a pulse has root?

options.A: The beat is regular and even in rhythm at all three positions
options.B: The beat remains perceptible at the chi positions on deep pressure
options.C: The beat is gentle, calm, and of moderate rate at the middle level
options.D: The beat arrives and departs smoothly with a soft, relaxed quality
